crossRefs.note: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another…
Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have…

translations.web: Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.
translations.bsb: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ the prophets speak two or three, and let ➔ the other judge.
translations.asv: And let the prophets speak by two or three, and let the others discern.
